# `stack`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
stack(n, expr1, ..., exprk)
```

Separates `expr1`, ..., `exprk` into `n` rows. Uses column names col0, col1, etc. by default unless specified otherwise.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `generator_funcs` |
| Kind | generator (function) |
| Added in Spark | 2.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | > 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- stack, example 1
> SELECT stack(2, 1, 2, 3);
1 | 2
3 | NULL
```
